qa_pairs.question: How does one obtain the AdditiveWizard.wbex file for Ansys Additive Manufacturing?
qa_pairs.answer: The AdditiveWizard.wbex file for Ansys Additive Manufacturing must first be downloaded from https://catalog.ansys.com/, and then uploaded to the cluster where it will be utilized.

qa_pairs.question: What are the initial steps to start Ansys Workbench and open a project file when enabling the Additive Manufacturing ACT extension?
qa_pairs.answer: To start Ansys Workbench, first follow the instructions outlined in the "Workbench" section under "Graphical use". Once Workbench is running, select 'File -> Open' from the GUI and choose your project file, which typically has a .wbpj extension.

qa_pairs.question: How do you access the extensions manager in Ansys Workbench?
qa_pairs.answer: To open the extensions manager in Ansys Workbench, click on the ACT start page. This action will open the ACT home page tab, where you can then click on "Manage Extensions" to access the manager.
